name: SonarQube
label: SonarQube Web API
description: SonarQube Web API via OfficialApiNode. Docs: https://docs.sonarsource.com/sonarqube-server/latest/extension-guide/web-api/. Operations: project_get, project_create, issue_search, measures_get, qualitygate_get, qualitygate_status, listen. Auth secret token is instance config only (never on INPUT, never logged). listen/trigger are kind:ingress — use a BPMN message start/catch/boundary event. Failures are output.error. JDK HTTP, official API only.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Per-operation fields. Do not put secrets here. Path params such as id match api_spec.json placeholders.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Which official API call to run. EXACT values: project_get | project_create | issue_search | measures_get | qualitygate_get | qualitygate_status | listen. Prefer the instance config operation select. listen/trigger are ingress: they do not call HTTP — use a BPMN message event. Example: 'project_get'.

schema.label: component
schema.description: Project key.

schema.label: projectKey
schema.description: Project key for QG status.

schema.label: impactSeverities
schema.description: Optional GET /issues/search query impactSeverities (INFO,LOW,MEDIUM,HIGH,BLOCKER). MQR filter; severities remains valid. https://docs.sonarsource.com/sonarqube-server/latest/extension-guide/web-api/

schema.label: metricKeys
schema.description: Comma-separated metric keys.

schema.label: name
schema.description: Project display name for project_create (required) or quality gate name for qualitygate_get. Example: Payments Service.

schema.label: visibility
schema.description: Project visibility for project_create. EXACT: private | public. Empty uses the organization / instance default. Example: private.

schema.label: mainBranch
schema.description: Main branch name for project_create. Empty uses main. Example: master.

schema.label: project
schema.description: Project key for project_create (API query param `project`). Alias: projectKey.

schema.label: id
schema.description: Quality gate id for qualitygate_get.

schema.label: organization
schema.description: SonarCloud organization key for project_create and issue_search.

schema.label: projects
schema.description: Comma-separated project keys for issue_search.

schema.label: projectKeys
schema.description: Deprecated issue_search filter (comma-separated keys). Prefer projects or componentKeys.

schema.label: assignees
schema.description: Comma-separated assignee logins for issue_search.

schema.label: issues
schema.description: Comma-separated issue keys for issue_search.

schema.label: projectId
schema.description: Project id for qualitygate_status (alternative to projectKey).

schema.label: analysisId
schema.description: Analysis uuid for qualitygate_status.

schema.label: branch
schema.description: Optional branch for qualitygate_status.

schema.label: componentKeys
schema.description: Query-string parameter `componentKeys` for operation: issue_search.

schema.label: severities
schema.description: Query-string parameter `severities` for operation: issue_search.

schema.label: ps
schema.description: issue_search page size (ps). Max 500. Omitted when blank.

schema.label: p
schema.description: issue_search page index (p). 1-based. Omitted when blank.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success {status:ok, http_status, data}. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: Status
schema.description: Exact ok on HTTP 2xx. Absent on failure.

schema.label: HTTP Status
schema.description: Provider HTTP status code.

schema.label: Data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body from the official API, or raw text.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Official API operation. EXACT: project_get, project_create, issue_search, measures_get, qualitygate_get, qualitygate_status, listen. listen is BPMN ingress, not a socket.

configurationParameters.label: Token
configurationParameters.description: SonarQube / SonarCloud user token. Authorization: Bearer. Never log or place on INPUT.

configurationParameters.label: Server URL
configurationParameters.description: SonarQube Server URL (scheme + host[:port], no trailing slash, without /api). Empty uses SonarCloud https://sonarcloud.io. Example: https://sonar.example.com.

configurationParameters.label: Default component key
configurationParameters.description: Default project/component key for project_get and measures_get when INPUT omits component. Also available on INPUT as component.

configurationParameters.label: Default organization
configurationParameters.description: Default SonarCloud organization for project_create / issue_search when INPUT omits organization.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: Connect + read timeout. Default 25. Keep at or below the daemon stateful budget (~300s).
